Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: an enormous real human hand reaches in from the side of the frame with its index finger curled into a loop, the fine skin creases, knuckle wrinkles and fingerprints in sharp macro detail, a natural sheen on the skin and a glossy manicured fingernail as large as a shield; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on the top of the giant curled finger, resting in a real place: a classical Chinese garden with a stone path, a zigzag bridge with a waist-high rail, a moon gate of standard height and a pavilion, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, shown softly blurred in the far background with a shallow depth of field. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous finger, knuckle and fingernail around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly visible dangling in the air. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
